content: The McGuire twins, born Billy Leon and Benny Loyd McCrary on December 7, 1946, were recognized as the World's Heaviest Twins by the Guinness Book of World Records, weighing 328 kg and 338 kg respectively. A well-known photograph in the Guinness Book depicts them riding their Honda motorcycles. Using the stage name McGuire, the twins gained fame as tag-team wrestlers and performers in carnival stunt shows. Billy McCrary tragically passed away on July 14, 1979, at the age of 32, following a motorcycle accident during a stunt at Niagara Falls. Benny McCrary lived for an additional 21 years, passing away at the age of 54 on March 14, 2001. In popular culture, the McGuire twins have been referenced in various media. In the Family Guy episode Blind Ambition, two characters are depicted as the world's fattest twins. In this episode, one twin mentions trying the Atkins diet, a high-protein diet often used for weight loss, while the other twin criticizes the diet, stating it is not good for you, reflecting a common critique of the diet. The twins have also appeared multiple times in The Simpsons. They were featured as surprise witnesses for Lionel Hutz and as mannequins in a large men's clothing store in the episode King-Size Homer. They are consistently portrayed riding their motorcycles.
